_source: Built from Brave's Web Search API reference (https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/api-reference/web/search/get), its Web Search overview (https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/documentation/web-search/responses) and its rate-limiting guide (https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/documentation/guides/rate-limiting). Brave publishes the response schema and one illustrative web.results fragment rather than a whole reply: the success body embeds that fragment (title, url, description, extra_snippets) in the documented envelope and fills the other documented fields with example values, and the empty and malformed bodies drop sections from it. Error bodies follow the documented error object (id, status, code, detail, meta). The SUBSCRIPTION_TOKEN_INVALID code and detail come from clients of the live API (zylon-ai/private-gpt tests/components/web_search/test_brave_provider.py); the other codes and details are illustrative. Rate-limit headers follow the guide's examples; no Retry-After is documented.
